apps.name: Mozilla Firefox
apps.hint: Open-source browser from Mozilla with strong tracking protection.
apps.description: Gecko-based browser with Enhanced Tracking Protection, containers and a large extension catalog. Updates itself after installation.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.hint: Google's Chromium-based browser with account sync.
apps.description: The most widely used browser, with Google account sync and the Chrome Web Store. Installs a background updater service.

apps.name: Brave
apps.hint: Chromium-based browser that blocks ads and trackers by default.
apps.description: Brave Shields blocks ads, trackers and fingerprinting out of the box. Optional crypto and AI features can be turned off in its settings.

apps.name: Vivaldi
apps.hint: Highly customizable Chromium-based browser with tab stacking and a built-in mail client.
apps.description: Chromium-based browser for power users: tab stacking and tiling, keyboard shortcuts, a built-in ad blocker, mail and calendar.

apps.name: LibreWolf
apps.hint: Privacy-hardened Firefox build with telemetry removed and uBlock Origin included.
apps.description: A community fork of Firefox with privacy-focused defaults, no telemetry and uBlock Origin preinstalled. Some sites need exceptions because of the strict defaults.

apps.name: Discord
apps.hint: Voice, video and text chat for gaming communities.
apps.description: Desktop client for Discord servers and calls. Its overlay works with most games; turn off hardware acceleration in its settings if it causes stutter.

apps.name: TeamSpeak 3
apps.hint: Low-latency voice chat client used by clans and esports teams.
apps.description: Classic voice client with self-hostable servers, push-to-talk and low CPU use.

apps.name: Mumble
apps.hint: Open-source, low-latency voice chat with positional audio.
apps.description: Encrypted, low-latency voice chat with positional audio for supported games. Servers can be self-hosted with Murmur.

apps.name: Telegram Desktop
apps.hint: Desktop client for the Telegram messenger.
apps.description: Cloud-based messaging with groups, channels and file sharing. Secret chats (end-to-end encrypted) are available on mobile only.

apps.name: Signal
apps.hint: End-to-end encrypted messenger; links to the Signal app on your phone.
apps.description: Private messaging and calls with the Signal protocol. The desktop app must be linked to Signal on a phone.

apps.name: Zoom Workplace
apps.hint: Video meetings and webinars.
apps.description: Desktop client for Zoom meetings, chat and screen sharing.

apps.name: Slack
apps.hint: Team chat for work and communities.
apps.description: Channels, direct messages, calls and integrations for teams.

apps.name: Microsoft Teams
apps.hint: Microsoft's chat and meeting app for work and school accounts.
apps.description: The new Microsoft Teams client for chat, meetings and calls with Microsoft 365 work or school accounts.

apps.name: Steam
apps.hint: Valve's game store and launcher.
apps.description: Game library, store, friends, Big Picture and Steam Input. Games and their anti-cheat are installed through Steam.

apps.name: Epic Games Launcher
apps.hint: Epic's game store and launcher (Fortnite, free weekly games).
apps.description: Store and launcher for Epic Games titles, including Fortnite and the weekly free games.

apps.name: GOG GALAXY
apps.hint: DRM-free GOG store and a launcher that can integrate other libraries.
apps.description: Launcher for GOG.com games with optional integrations for other platforms.

apps.name: EA app
apps.hint: Electronic Arts' launcher (EA SPORTS FC, Battlefield, Apex Legends).
apps.description: Store and launcher for EA titles; installs the EA Background Service.

apps.name: Ubisoft Connect
apps.hint: Ubisoft's launcher (Rainbow Six Siege, Assassin's Creed).
apps.description: Store and launcher for Ubisoft titles; Ubisoft+ subscriptions and cloud saves run through it.

apps.name: Battle.net
apps.hint: Blizzard's launcher (Overwatch 2, Diablo, World of Warcraft, Call of Duty).
apps.description: Installs the Battle.net desktop app, which downloads and patches Blizzard and Activision games.

apps.name: Playnite
apps.hint: Open-source launcher that unifies Steam, Epic, GOG, EA, Ubisoft and emulator libraries.
apps.description: One library for all launchers, with extensions and a fullscreen mode for controllers.

apps.name: NVIDIA GeForce NOW
apps.hint: NVIDIA's cloud gaming client.
apps.description: Streams games you own from NVIDIA's servers. Latency depends on your connection; run the network test first.

apps.name: MSI Afterburner
apps.hint: GPU monitoring, fan curves and frame-time graphs.
apps.description: Hardware monitoring and fan control for most GPUs. iG Windows Tuner never overclocks or changes voltages; Afterburner can, so change those only if you know the risk.
apps.note: Use the monitoring features; overclocking and voltage changes are your own responsibility.

apps.name: RivaTuner Statistics Server
apps.hint: On-screen FPS and frame-time overlay with an accurate frame limiter.
apps.description: Shows FPS, frame times and sensor data in games and provides a precise frame-rate limiter. Its overlay is accepted by the common anti-cheats.

apps.name: LatencyMon
apps.hint: Measures DPC and ISR latency to find drivers that cause audio crackle and stutter.
apps.description: Free for home use. Run it while idle and while gaming; compare with iG Windows Tuner's DPC/ISR diagnostics.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.hint: Open-source streaming and recording with NVENC, AMF and Quick Sync encoders.
apps.description: The standard tool for streaming and recording. Use the GPU encoder to keep game performance.

apps.name: VLC media player
apps.hint: Plays almost every audio and video format.
apps.description: Open-source media player with built-in codecs.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.hint: Music streaming desktop app.
apps.description: Spotify desktop client. Turn off hardware acceleration and start-at-login in its settings if you do not need them.

apps.name: HandBrake
apps.hint: Open-source video transcoder with hardware encoders.
apps.description: Converts video between formats and sizes with x264, x265, NVENC, AMF and Quick Sync.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.hint: Open-source audio recorder and editor.
apps.description: Records, edits and cleans up audio such as voice-overs and podcasts.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.hint: Open-source image editor.
apps.description: Raster image editing with layers, masks and plugins.

apps.name: Krita
apps.hint: Open-source digital painting app.
apps.description: Painting and illustration with brush engines and pen-tablet support.

apps.name: Blender
apps.hint: Open-source 3D creation suite.
apps.description: Modeling, animation, rendering (Cycles, EEVEE) and video editing.

apps.name: ShareX
apps.hint: Open-source screenshot and screen-recording tool.
apps.description: Region capture, GIF and video recording, annotations and upload targets.

apps.name: FFmpeg
apps.hint: Command-line audio and video converter.
apps.description: The FFmpeg tools (ffmpeg, ffprobe, ffplay) for conversion and stream processing.

apps.name: Elgato Stream Deck
apps.hint: Software for Elgato Stream Deck controllers.
apps.description: Configures Stream Deck keys for OBS, Discord and system actions. Runs at sign-in.

apps.name: Voicemeeter Banana
apps.hint: Virtual audio mixer for streaming and voice chat routing.
apps.description: Mixes and routes microphones, game and chat audio. Installs virtual audio drivers; a reboot is needed.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.hint: Microsoft's code editor with extensions, Git and debugging.
apps.description: Lightweight editor with IntelliSense, debugging, Git and remote development (WSL, SSH, containers).

apps.name: Git
apps.hint: Git version control for Windows, with Git Bash.
apps.description: The Git command-line tools, Git Bash and Git Credential Manager.

apps.name: GitHub Desktop
apps.hint: Graphical Git client for GitHub.
apps.description: Clone, commit, branch and publish to GitHub without the command line.

apps.name: GitHub CLI
apps.hint: The gh command-line tool for GitHub.
apps.description: Work with pull requests, issues, releases and Actions from the terminal.

apps.name: PowerShell 7
apps.hint: Cross-platform PowerShell 7, side by side with Windows PowerShell 5.1.
apps.description: The current PowerShell release. iG Windows Tuner runs on both 5.1 and 7.

apps.name: Windows Terminal
apps.hint: Microsoft's tabbed terminal for PowerShell, Command Prompt and WSL.
apps.description: Tabs, panes, profiles and GPU text rendering. Already inbox on recent Windows 11 builds.

apps.name: Python 3.13
apps.hint: The Python 3.13 interpreter from python.org.
apps.description: Python runtime with pip and the py launcher.

apps.name: Node.js LTS
apps.hint: The long-term-support Node.js runtime with npm.
apps.description: JavaScript runtime for tooling and servers.

apps.name: Docker Desktop
apps.hint: Containers on Windows using WSL 2.
apps.description: Needs WSL 2 and Virtual Machine Platform (Toolkit > Features). Free for personal and small-business use; larger companies need a subscription.

apps.name: .NET 10 SDK
apps.hint: The .NET 10 SDK for building .NET apps.
apps.description: Compilers, runtime and the dotnet CLI for .NET 10.

apps.name: Visual Studio Community 2022
apps.hint: Microsoft's full IDE for C++, C# and game development.
apps.description: Free for individuals, open source and small teams. Choose workloads in the installer that opens.

apps.name: JetBrains Toolbox
apps.hint: Installs and updates JetBrains IDEs (Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm).
apps.description: Manages JetBrains IDE installations and updates.

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.hint: Fast source-code and text editor.
apps.description: Tabbed editor with syntax highlighting and plugins.

apps.name: Neovim
apps.hint: Extensible, keyboard-driven text editor.
apps.description: Modern Vim with Lua configuration and LSP support.

apps.name: Rustup
apps.hint: Installs and manages the Rust toolchain.
apps.description: Installs rustc, cargo and toolchains. Needs the Visual Studio C++ build tools.

apps.name: Go
apps.hint: The Go programming language toolchain.
apps.description: The Go compiler, standard library and the go command for building and testing Go programs.

apps.name: WinSCP
apps.hint: SFTP, SCP and FTP client.
apps.description: Transfers files to servers and NAS devices over SFTP, SCP or FTP.

apps.name: PuTTY
apps.hint: SSH and serial terminal client.
apps.description: Classic SSH, Telnet and serial client. Windows also includes the OpenSSH client.

apps.name: 7-Zip
apps.hint: Open-source file archiver (7z, zip, rar extraction).
apps.description: Packs and extracts archives with a high compression ratio and Explorer integration.

apps.name: Everything
apps.hint: Instant file-name search for NTFS drives.
apps.description: Finds files by name immediately using the NTFS index. Runs a small background service.

apps.name: PowerToys
apps.hint: Microsoft's utilities: FancyZones, PowerToys Run, color picker and more.
apps.description: A set of Microsoft-supported utilities for power users. Enable only the modules you use.

apps.name: CPU-Z
apps.hint: Shows CPU, motherboard and memory details.
apps.description: Identifies CPU, chipset, memory timings and SPD data.

apps.name: GPU-Z
apps.hint: Shows GPU details, Resizable BAR status and sensors.
apps.description: Identifies the graphics card, its BIOS, bus interface and sensors.

apps.name: HWMonitor
apps.hint: Shows temperatures, voltages and fan speeds.
apps.description: Simple monitor for CPU, GPU and drive temperatures, voltages and fan speeds with minimum and maximum values.

apps.name: HWiNFO
apps.hint: Detailed hardware information and sensor logging.
apps.description: In-depth hardware report and sensor logging, useful for checking thermals and clocks under load.

apps.name: CrystalDiskInfo
apps.hint: Shows SSD and HDD health (SMART).
apps.description: Reads SMART health, temperatures and lifetime writes of your drives.

apps.name: CrystalDiskMark
apps.hint: Disk speed benchmark.
apps.description: Measures sequential and random read/write speed of a drive.

apps.name: WinDirStat
apps.hint: Visual disk usage analyzer.
apps.description: Shows what uses space as a treemap. iG Windows Tuner also has a read-only disk analyzer.

apps.name: WizTree
apps.hint: Very fast disk space analyzer.
apps.description: Reads the NTFS master file table to show folder sizes in seconds. Free for personal use.

apps.name: Rufus
apps.hint: Creates bootable USB drives from ISO images.
apps.description: Writes Windows and Linux installers to USB drives.

apps.name: Bulk Crap Uninstaller
apps.hint: Uninstalls many programs at once and finds leftovers.
apps.description: Batch uninstaller with leftover detection. Review leftovers before deleting them.

apps.name: Autoruns
apps.hint: Microsoft Sysinternals: every auto-start location.
apps.description: Shows everything that starts with Windows. iG Windows Tuner's persistence inspector covers the common locations read-only.

apps.name: Process Explorer
apps.hint: Microsoft Sysinternals: an advanced Task Manager.
apps.description: Shows process trees, handles, DLLs and signature checks.

apps.name: Process Monitor
apps.hint: Microsoft Sysinternals: real-time file, registry and process activity.
apps.description: Traces what a program reads and writes, for troubleshooting.

apps.name: TCPView
apps.hint: Microsoft Sysinternals: live view of TCP and UDP connections.
apps.description: Shows which process owns each network connection.

apps.name: WinDbg
apps.hint: Microsoft's debugger, for analyzing crash dumps.
apps.description: Opens minidumps from %SystemRoot%\Minidump to find the faulting driver (!analyze -v).

apps.name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
apps.hint: Installs or updates WSL from the winget package.
apps.description: The Store-delivered WSL package. Enable the WSL and Virtual Machine Platform features first (Toolkit > Features).

apps.name: Wireshark
apps.hint: Network protocol analyzer.
apps.description: Captures and decodes network traffic. Installs the Npcap capture driver.

apps.name: Speedtest CLI
apps.hint: Ookla's command-line internet speed test.
apps.description: Measures download, upload and latency to Ookla servers. A load test: do not run it during games.

apps.name: WifiInfoView
apps.hint: Shows nearby Wi-Fi networks, channels and signal strength.
apps.description: Lists nearby Wi-Fi networks with channel, band and signal strength, which helps choose a free channel and band.

apps.name: Remote Desktop client
apps.hint: Microsoft's Remote Desktop client for Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365.
apps.description: Connects to Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 and Remote Desktop Services feeds.

apps.name: BGInfo
apps.hint: Microsoft Sysinternals: system information on the desktop background.
apps.description: Shows host name, IP and OS details on the wallpaper, handy for labs and servers.

apps.name: Azure CLI
apps.hint: Command-line tools for Microsoft Azure.
apps.description: The az command for managing Azure resources.

apps.name: Azure Storage Explorer
apps.hint: Browse and manage Azure storage accounts.
apps.description: Graphical client for blobs, files, queues and tables.

apps.name: SQL Server Management Studio
apps.hint: Microsoft's management tool for SQL Server and Azure SQL.
apps.description: Query, administer and monitor SQL Server databases.

apps.name: mRemoteNG
apps.hint: Tabbed remote connections manager (RDP, SSH, VNC).
apps.description: Keeps many remote connections in one window. Protect its connection file with a password.

apps.name: Advanced IP Scanner
apps.hint: Scans your own network for devices and open shares.
apps.description: Finds devices on your LAN. Scan only networks you are responsible for.

apps.name: Windows ADK
apps.hint: Windows Assessment and Deployment Kit (WPA, WPR, deployment tools).
apps.description: Includes Windows Performance Recorder and Analyzer for precise latency tracing, and deployment tools.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.hint: Open-source password manager with cloud sync.
apps.description: Stores passwords and passkeys end-to-end encrypted.

apps.name: KeePassXC
apps.hint: Offline, open-source password manager.
apps.description: Keeps passwords in a local encrypted database (KeePass format).

apps.name: VeraCrypt
apps.hint: Encrypted containers and drive encryption.
apps.description: Creates encrypted volumes. On Windows Pro, BitLocker is the integrated alternative for the system drive.

apps.name: WireGuard
apps.hint: Fast, modern VPN client.
apps.description: Official WireGuard client. The VPN client manages its own adapter MTU.

apps.name: Proton VPN
apps.hint: VPN service from Proton with a free tier.
apps.description: Client for Proton VPN. A VPN adds latency to game traffic unless you split-tunnel games.

apps.name: Tailscale
apps.hint: Mesh VPN built on WireGuard for your own devices.
apps.description: Connects your devices securely without opening ports.

apps.name: Yubico Authenticator
apps.hint: Authenticator app for YubiKey-stored codes.
apps.description: Shows the one-time (TOTP) codes stored on a YubiKey, so the secrets never leave the key.

apps.name: Gpg4win
apps.hint: OpenPGP encryption and signing for Windows.
apps.description: GnuPG with Kleopatra for file and mail encryption and signature checks.
